cards.title: ULTIMATE
cards.body: Roblox scripter. I build the systems that make your game play.

cards.title: I script whole games, not just pieces.
cards.body: A year learning to code in Luau, then two years building my own games from scratch. If your game needs it, I can code it.

cards.title: ELEMENTUM
cards.body: My biggest project. A full pro-bending game with 13 systems. You'll step inside it in a moment.

cards.title: Gun combat system
cards.body: First-person guns from scratch: recoil, sway, aiming and real reloads. Every shot is re-checked on the server, so nobody can fake a hit.

cards.title: Round-based elemental combat
cards.body: Rounds, countdowns, live score, teams and spectating. Light and heavy attacks, parry, dash and walls.

cards.title: Game UI & inventory
cards.body: A full menu layer: lobby HUD, inventory, shop, codes, mode picker and a rewards track. One style, smooth transitions.

cards.title: ELEMENTUM
cards.body: Avatar Pro-bending inspired game. 13 systems and 39,000+ lines of Luau. Keep scrolling and I'll walk you through them.

cards.title: Combat that feels fair.
cards.body: Fire and earth moves, parries, dodges and knockback. The server decides every hit, so what players see is what really happened.

cards.title: Bots that fight back.
cards.body: Those two throwing at me are AI. They aim, dodge and pick moves like a player would, so matches never feel empty.

cards.title: Menus players actually use.
cards.body: Shop, inventory, profile, emotes and rewards. Every panel opens fast and works on phone and PC.

cards.title: Queue up. Rank up.
cards.body: 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 matchmaking, parties, ranked play and a tutorial. Progress saves safely, so nobody loses their stuff.

cards.title: So I build the defence in.
bullets: The server decides hits, cooldowns and damage. The client only asks.
Every request is rate limited, so spam gets dropped.
Movement is watched for speed and teleport hacks.
Coins and rewards only change on the server.

cards.title: Simple from start to finish.
bullets: You tell me what your game needs.
I give you a price before I start.
I build it. You test it in your game.
Fixes on my work are free.

cards.title: First 5 commissions are free.
cards.body: After that, these are my prices.
rows: Door, leaderboard, simple GUI, one tool
Shop, inventory, round system, data saving
Full combat, anti-exploit, complete game loop
cards.note: PayPal (USD) or Robux. For Robux you cover Roblox's 30% fee.

cards.title: Pick up. Let's build your game.
cards.body: Message me with what you need, a rough deadline and your budget.
